about.heading: My Story
about.paragraph: Software Engineer graduated from UNIPOLI with experience in back-end development, data analysis, and scalable architectures. I specialize in Java with Spring Boot and Python, MySQL optimization, and large-scale data analysis. I build robust systems with clean code and efficient database design.
